ValidationRule.description: Drive date cannot be moved to complete if the drive date is greater than today.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT(ISNEW()) && ISCHANGED(sked_Status__c) && sked_Drive_Date__c > TODAY() && ISPICKVAL(sked_Status__c, "Complete") && $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator' && $Profile.Name <> 'Global Admin'
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The drive status cannot be set to 'Complete' because the drive date is greater than today.
